plan.objective: Recover Cx,Cy,R,f,theta and unknown bounded background/material levels from independently generated observed fields, retaining smooth, float32 staged and PNG objectives, all initialization refusals and failures. Not physical or global qualification.

reference.source: positive vertical slice area from separately frozen sensitivity reference; no candidate area/Green functions
reference.stages: scalar reflected correlations and unfactored Keys cubics summed with math.fsum; explicit float32 casts and grayscale sRGB8 sequence in corresponding modes
reference.error_estimates: Order agreement is a diagnostic, not a certified area/physical bound. Arithmetic differences from factored/tap evaluation are retained.

initialization.source: prepare_acquisition_segment observed full field only; no geometry/evaluation dimensions
initialization.rules: fixed immutable full field and acquisition map/stages; no truth-based seed ranking, expansion, exclusion or retry
initialization.bounds: observed-only operational search limits; no guaranteed truth containment
initialization.levels: observed output-level hints supplied as rounded-mode seeds, not calibrated source levels

optimizer.normal_angle: ideal continuous unit-angle family approximated by trig and public normal canonicalization; bit-level exact derivative not asserted
optimizer.smooth: bounded two-level SVD variable projection with full fixed-face residual Jacobian, mean-based nuisance-projected rank, dimensionless damped LM/backtracking and actual-cost polling fallback
optimizer.staged_png: actual rounded chain, bounded local geometry/brightness polls; no exact variable projection/globality or smooth-rank claim

sampling.train: all initializer queries except (x+2*y)%5==0; five-query adverse retains first5 deterministic training rows
sampling.reserved: remaining queries, omitted from cost but used in full-field initialization: conditional residual checks, not independent predictions
sampling.reserved_dimensions: truth chord_length and normal_depth opened only after initializer and optimizer result files are saved; not initializer/optimizer inputs

targets.scope: Per-row predeclared synthetic targets; PNG/staged plateaus may fail. Adverse rows retain target flags but are not claimed successes merely for executing/refusing.
targets.bounded_local_search_completion: best candidate belongs to at least one projected-gradient/poll-resolution search; no exhausted work or protocol failure. Local resolution does not establish globality or physical adequacy.

adverse_definitions.low: source levels132,130; keep declared polarity even if contradicted
adverse_definitions.wrong: fit optical kernel[[1]] while capture retains declared asymmetric kernel
adverse_definitions.five: fit only first5 deterministic training queries

plan.failure_policy: Freeze complete implementation/tests/plan/runner/reference before first numerical call. Retain every row, raw exception and upstream refusal; continue remaining rows; do not tune thresholds, truth-derived bounds or population after outcomes. Corrections require a separately admitted continuation. Exit1 if any matched row misses any target or reference gate; adverse outcomes summarized without acceptance promotion. Fresh output directory required.

continuation_admission.reason: All four smooth matched rows passed; eight literal rounded rows failed, including local poll plateaus and work/iteration limits. First budget test incorrectly required the first seed to lose its valid local stopping status when a later seed hit the global cap. Originals are preserved before corrections.

strategy.smooth: Pass through the original local fitter without a proposal phase.
strategy.rounded: Use up to floor(one quarter) of each total evaluation, source-cell and stage-product cap for a smooth observed-data proposal phase using all original seeds. Select the represented minimum-cost candidate (index breaks ties), then use only its geometry and profiled levels as one literal rounded starting point. Preserve all alternatives and selection provenance.
strategy.fallback: When no valid proposal or insufficient proposal quota is available, use original seeds with the remaining actual total resources. Refuse/withhold unsafe or unknown work; never erase failures.
strategy.scheduling_scope: New local strategy with observed-cost proposal selection, not an exhaustive rounded multistart or global search.
strategy.global_budget: Charge both phases against the same original total caps; proposal quota exhaustion remains separately visible and is not automatically total-cap exhaustion.
strategy.literal_objective: Original actual float32 staged or PNG acquisition objective; no exact rounded variable projection, smooth rounded derivative, rank or convergence theorem is asserted.
strategy.completion_gate: Original completion target plus explicit completion_withheld=False for unknown work or invalid source/protocol provenance. Individual phase/search statuses remain unchanged.
strategy.late_exception_gate: The original runner can set row all_targets before later diagnostic errors. This continuation retains the previous flag and complete exception but forces any non-completed row to all_targets=False before it is counted; report counts/pass are reconciled. The frozen original runner/report remain untouched.

unchanged.targets: Every original geometry, boundary, dimension, conditional-residual, rank and local-completion criterion retains its numeric threshold.
unchanged.initialization: Same observed-only initializer, max4seeds, operational bounds, level hints and clipping.
unchanged.reference: Same independent positive-slice GL64/96 captures and independent candidate evaluation; original reference gate unchanged.
unchanged.sampling: Same training/reserved deterministic split, including first5trainingindices for adverse row; reserved checks remain conditional due full-field initialization.
unchanged.budgets: Same total2048evaluations,1000000cellunits and100000000stageproducts across both phases. The existing max60iterations applies per seed within each original-fitter phase, not to aggregate iterations or wall time.
unchanged.no_truth_inputs: Truth/evaluation dimensions opened only after complete fit outputs are saved.

test_correction.replacement: Retain valid first-seed local resolution under max_evaluations=1; require a later denied search/ledger, exact started-or-unstarted seed census, same caps and global incomplete status.
test_correction.does_not_change: No optimizer source, tolerance, step, budget, scientific population, original study result or target is changed by this unit-contract correction.

prospective_checks: New wrapper routing, deterministic observed-cost selection, resource sums/quotas, no-hidden-calls, fixed/zero brightness, malformed/opaque/source failures, immutable input/result contracts and smooth pass-through.
Independent short-chord sampling-alias, stored-normal q-corrected angle-flux bound, signed-Keys propagation and conservative brightness-rank ceiling controls.
All focused original tests plus new tests run only after complete implementation/tests/admission/continuation are committed and hashed.
Complete24-row continuation; retain every refusal, exception, first failure and unchanged-target result. No after-result threshold or population adjustment.
Independent saved-only original-run auditor uses recorded source ZIP, never compares archived source binding to unrelated current code.
A late row exception cannot retain an overall pass even when its earlier evaluation targets were True; original diagnostics remain in the saved row and aggregate counters match gated rows.
continuation_admission.freeze_policy: All backend modules, all test_finite modules, original plan/runner/reference/helper, this admission, new continuation and saved-data auditor are committed and hashed before first new model/test call. No imports/tests/models during authoring. Corrections after results require another admission.
continuation_admission.failure_policy: Exit1 unless all12matchedrows pass every unchanged target, reference gate and source/provenance requirement. All24rows and complete phase ledgers retained. Adverse execution/refusal never promoted to recovery success.
continuation_admission.limits: Public synthetic model qualification only; no real-camera, noise, globality, native slicer or physical-print claim.
